statements.statement: The policy does not cover damage to the windscreen, windows or sunroof on its own.
statements.quote: [6.3 Windscreen and window damage] This version of the policy does not cover damage to the windscreen, windows or sunroof on its own.

statements.statement: Damage to these parts must be part of a collision claim.
statements.quote: [6.3 Windscreen and window damage] Glass broken in the same collision as other damage to the vehicle is paid as part of the collision claim under section 4.1.
